Which of the following statements is/are correct for the Verilog language?
A.An always block sensitive to the posedge of a signal will be triggered if that signal transitions from 0 to x.
B.An always block sensitive to the negedge of a signal will be triggered if that signal transitions from 0 to 1.
C.An initial block executes only once and stops when it reaches the end of the block.
D.We can use any logical operator, such as or, nor, and, nand, xor, etc., in the sensitivity list of an always block.

questions.html:
Which of the following statements is/are correct for coverage metrics for an RTL design?
A.Code coverage identifies sections of given RTL code that did not execute during simulation.
B.Functional coverage identifies whether the specified features in the given coverage model execute during simulation.
C.Extracting functional coverage metrics requires more effort, as we need to develop a separate coverage model to specify the design features to be verified.
D.Code coverage is a good metric for monitoring the progress of the verification effort.

questions.html:
Which of the following statements is/are correct for RTL simulators?
A.Event-driven simulation involves computing a chain of events and their responses until no further events are available.
B.Cycle-based simulators evaluate the sequence of next states at successive clock edges as a function of the present state and the present input.
C.Cycle-based simulators are typically employed to simulate asynchronous circuits because they don’t have a periodic clock signal.
